description: Product workflows where current state, limitations, and real recovery actions must remain exact.

cases.context: 文件导入详情页。解析在第 214 行失败，已导入的记录没有保存；页面只有重新上传入口。

inputCopy.text: Parser pipeline 在 row 214 抛错，请完成修复闭环。

verifiedFacts: 本次导入没有保存任何记录
用户可以重新上传文件
mustPreservePropositions: 说明本次没有保存记录
只提供重新上传这一真实恢复动作
mustRemoveIntents: 暴露内部阶段编号、验收和修复闭环语言
把解析器实现名称作为用户解释
mustNotInfer: 具体字段或格式错误原因
可重试当前任务或恢复部分记录
cases.rationale: 错误文案必须从内部流水线语言转成可验证的当前状态和唯一恢复路径。

cases.context: A billing settings panel. Legal approved the renewal sentence. The current viewer can see the plan but cannot change it; no request-access control exists.

inputCopy.text: Your subscription renews automatically on October 1 unless canceled before renewal.
Implementation note: hide mutation controls for viewer role

approvedCopy.text: Your subscription renews automatically on October 1 unless canceled before renewal.

verifiedFacts: The subscription renews automatically on October 1 unless canceled before renewal
The viewer role cannot change the plan
mustPreservePropositions: Preserve the approved renewal sentence verbatim
State that the viewer cannot change the plan
mustRemoveIntents: Expose the implementation note or mutation-control terminology
mustNotInfer: A route to cancel, manage, upgrade, or request access
A different renewal date or cancellation condition
The reason the viewer has read-only access
layoutConstraints: Do not add a button or link
Keep the approved sentence as one unchanged copy fragment
cases.rationale: Natural wording cannot override approved legal copy or create a missing permission workflow.

cases.context: 分析报告导出说明。已确认导出物是固定、版本化的字段集合；页面只有下载该字段集合的入口。规划讨论否决了把全部回答交给一个模型生成整份报告，但稿子仍把否决项写进了界面。

inputCopy.text: 这条链路中不存在把全部回答交给一个模型、让它生成整份报告的步骤
导出器不返回无界报告 JSON。

verifiedFacts: 导出结果是固定、版本化的字段集合
用户可以下载该字段集合
mustPreservePropositions: 说明导出物是固定、版本化的字段集合
只提供下载该字段集合这一真实动作
mustRemoveIntents: 把已否决的整份报告生成方案写给用户
用“不返回无界报告 JSON”代替实际导出物
mustNotInfer: 可以下载整份自由文本报告
字段集合无版本或可任意扩展
会把全部回答交给一个模型重写报告
cases.rationale: 反向强调要把已否决路径从界面删除，并把否定契约改写成用户实际拿到的输出物；不能把真实限制一并抹掉。

cases.context: Export help on an analysis report. The confirmed artifact is a fixed, versioned field set, and the page only offers that download. Planning rejected handing every answer to one model to write the whole report, but the draft still explains the rejection to the user.

inputCopy.text: This flow has no step that hands every answer to one model to generate the entire report
The exporter does not return unbounded report JSON.

verifiedFacts: The export is a fixed, versioned field set
The user can download that field set
mustPreservePropositions: State that the export is a fixed, versioned field set
Offer only the download of that field set
mustRemoveIntents: Tell the user about the rejected whole-report generation path
Use “does not return unbounded report JSON” in place of the actual artifact
mustNotInfer: A download of an unbounded free-text report
An unversioned or arbitrarily expandable field set
That every answer will be sent to one model to rewrite the report
layoutConstraints: The heading fits in two lines
cases.rationale: Reverse emphasis should drop rejected-path residue and restate the real output; it must not delete genuine limitations.
